rules: Status uses exact matching unless the user says current employees, in which case use Status not in separated_statuses.
Numeric comparisons valid for Annual Salary, Bonus Target, Tenure (Years).

domain.description: An employee directory. Each row is an employee, with their department, role, employment status, work location, compensation, and tenure.

column_descriptions.Bonus Target: Target annual bonus amount for the employee.
column_descriptions.Tenure (Years): Number of years the employee has been with the organisation.
column_descriptions.Manager ID: The Employee ID of this employee's line manager.
column_descriptions.Status: Employment status (e.g. Active, On Leave, Terminated, Sabbatical).
column_descriptions.Role: The employee's role band (e.g. IC, Manager, Director, VP).
column_descriptions.Performance Score: Most recent performance review rating, 1.0 (lowest) to 5.0 (highest).
column_descriptions.Market Rate: External market benchmark salary for the employee's role.
column_descriptions.Equity Grant Value: Current value of the employee's equity grant.
column_descriptions.Time in Current Role (Years): Number of years the employee has held their current role (always <= Tenure (Years)).
